Dear Residents of Waterloo,
The C i ty of Waterloo has selected Republic Services as our vendor for the collection of
voluntary residential curbside recycling within the City of Waterloo effective
December 1, 2019. Republic Services will be the single vendor for the collection of
residential curbside recycling for our great City. One of the most exciting parts of this
new partnership with Republic Services is that there will now be twice per month
•c • •u rbside recycling collection!
•
The City will continue to collect your weekly refuse and yardwaste containers on the
seasonal schedule. The City will continue to maintain the satellite yard waste and
recycling sites that are currently available to Waterloo residents.
The updated fee changes for single family residential will be as follows on your
January 2020 Water Works billing:
$5.00 monthly yard waste and recycling drop off sites maintenance fee
$4.00 monthly fee for voluntary curbside yard waste and/or recycling collection
Regular Refuse rate:
Small (32gal) $10.00
Medium (64gal) $11.75
Large (96gal) $17.75
If you do not want any changes to your current recycling services, there is no action
required.
If you choose to change and/or add to your current recycling service, please mark
the appropriate boxes on the enclosed pre-addressed post card and then mail it in.
This will assist our office in assuring you are getting the right containers and service at
your residence.
We thank you in advance for your patience in this transition. We are excited about
our new partnership with Republic Services. If you have any questions, please feel
free to contact the Sanitation Department by phone at (319) 291-4445.
Sincerely,
